visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with several panning and static shots of traditional apartment buildings in Taiwan. The facades are densely packed with various styles of metal iron windows (grilles), ranging from simple rectangular bars to more decorative 'flower' patterns. The weather is sunny with clear natural light reflecting off the concrete walls. (2) The scene cuts to a sidewalk near a restaurant with a 'TGI FRIDAYS' sign. A person with short hair, glasses, and a vibrant patterned shirt is being interviewed by a hand holding a clipboard and microphone. Subtitles appear at the bottom center. (3) Transition to a park setting with bright green foliage. An elderly man wearing a white cap and light green jacket talks to the interviewer. Later, a younger man in a brown hat and glasses is also interviewed on a park bench. (4) A close-up shot of a bald man in a bright orange patterned shirt speaking expressively with hand gestures against a plain indoor wall background. (5) The location shifts to a metal workshop. A man in a navy blue polo shirt with yellow text on the chest speaks about iron window craftsmanship. Tools and metal stocks are visible in the cluttered background. (6) Two hosts, a female with short hair and a male in a white t-shirt, are seen laughing and looking at a smartphone screen. The screen displays a photo album titled '路上看到的鐵花窗' (Iron Flower Windows Seen on the Road), showcasing various artistic grille patterns.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 哈哈台 HahaTai. [Subtitle]: 看向台灣的街頭, 你一定能看到大量的鐵窗. (2) [Subtitle]: 究竟台灣人為什麼對裝鐵窗那麼執著? (3) [Subtitle]: 我爸爸媽媽家有, 可是我們那個是放花盆的. (4) [Subtitle]: 大哥你住的地方有鐵窗嗎? (5) [Variety]: 有. (6) [Subtitle]: 那你當初為什麼要裝鐵窗? (7) [Variety]: 遭小偷. (8) [Subtitle]: 以前大家都說是防盜. (9) [Variety]: 防盜. (10) [Subtitle]: 但我覺得比較多可能是為了多一個空間, 室內空間. (11) [Variety]: 室內空間. (12) [Subtitle]: 多那空間可以曬衣服. (13) [Subtitle]: 其實我不懂為什麼台灣有, 因為台灣常常有地震. (14) [Subtitle]: 如果這種門會因為地震歪起來, 就沒辦法離開, 逃不了. (15) [Variety]: 逃不了. (16) [Variety]: 大家都想屎嗎? (17) [Logo]: 鐵窗職人 曾文昌. [Subtitle]: 有些人說台灣的鐵窗文化是一個非常一個醜陋的弊病嘛. (18) [Subtitle]: 可是如果今天它是一個非常多樣性的一個花樣的話, 其實那是台灣一個特別的一個景觀這樣. (19) [Subtitle]: 其實我自己會有職業病, 不管它鐵窗好不好看啊, 或者漂亮不漂亮. (20) [Subtitle]: 我都會就過過去, 就會眼神就飄過去瞄它一下. (21) [Subtitle]: 當然遇到漂亮的時候我就會, 甚至去摸摸它, 然後去研究. (22) [Variety]: 你會去摸!!? 你很像那個要偷東西的人欸. (23) [Variety]: 百口摸辯. (24) [Subtitle]: 那個大哥你的手機裡面該不會存了很多那種路上看到的鐵窗. (25) [Subtitle]: 有有有, 這有. 可以看一下嗎? 可以可以. (26) [Variety]: 大哥有用個有一個相簿叫做路上看到的鐵花窗. (27) [Slogan]: 路上看到的鐵花窗 50個項目.
